thread:
marta: Hey team, dropping a compact-first-run mock for review. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/gothy/onboard-compact-v1 and a short Loom. Main questions: is the compact sample projects grid discoverable enough, does the reduced checklist feel too bare, and any accessibility traps? Please reply with :eyes: + 1 action item.

syl: :eyes: quick notes: I like the minimal checklist but we should surface 'Connect API key' earlier (above fold). Maybe highlight it with a subtle badge 'required'. For the grid, consider a 2-col on mobile -> 3-col on desktop with left-aligned titles.

dave: A11y scan from aria_bot shows missing alt text on demo thumbnails and a color contrast issue on secondary link text. Also the keyboard focus order goes from header -> banner CTA -> checkboxes -> cards which is confusing. Cards should be in the natural reading order after the checklist.

aria_bot: Automated a11y summary: 3 images missing alt text, 1 contrast fail (secondary link #6a6a6a on white), no aria-live on success toast. Report: https://a11y.report/redwood/onboard-compact-v1

nora: Copy tweaks: banner CTA 'Start with a sample project' vs 'Get started' — prefer the former. Checklist microcopy: 'Create a sample project (recommended)' then smaller text 'You can connect your own model later'. Also suggest contextual help icon next to API step with tooltip: 'Needed to make calls; stored for convenience only.'

marta: Good recs. Quick experiment idea: A/B compact vs spacious cards; primary metric = "complete onboarding" within 3 days; secondary = "first API call". Sample 1500 per arm. Can someone draft a short experiment spec?

syl: I'll draft the spec. Note: measurement requires instrumentation for 'completed onboarding' event - we have partial events from onboarding.checklist.* but need a final onboarding.completed event. Ping eng-analytics.

dave: I'll own the a11y fixes and add tests: alt text, focus order, aria-live, and color adjustments. Will validate with screen reader on mac and NVDA.

nora: I'll assemble copy variants (short vs descriptive) and add them to the doc for the experiment.

marta: Owners: syl -> experiment spec, dave -> a11y fixes & tests, nora -> copy variants. Please :thumbsup: when you've taken it.

syl: :thumbsup: I'll open the experiment ticket and coordinate with analytics.

dave: :thumbsup: Will PR the fixes to onboarding UI tomorrow.

nora: :thumbsup: Will add variants by Monday.

marta: Thanks! We'll sync this in Monday's product standup.
